wildcardHTTPRoute.description:
BackendTrafficPolicy attached to an external wildcard HTTPRoute (e.g. the
installer-created "wildcard-to-ingress") that forwards *.<subdomain> dev traffic
from the app Gateway to okteto-nginx. It disables Envoy's default request timeout
(for long-lived user-app connections) and lets websocket + spdy/3.1 Upgrade streams
pass through the Envoy edge, matching ingress-nginx's transparent passthrough.
Enable when that wildcard route is in use (Gateway edge in front of okteto-nginx).
Requires the Envoy Gateway BackendTrafficPolicy CRD.
